description.en: MR-LiDAR is a multi-resolution LiDAR benchmark for roadside perception. It includes point cloud data and annotations from 16-, 32-, 80-, and 128-beam LiDARs in identical scenarios, covering vehicles and vulnerable road users at various distances.
